methodology: Classification is hand-researched and authoritative; every domain and subdomain is re-verified live with dig NS, dig A/AAAA/CNAME, curl -sI -L and whois. Where the live check contradicts the seed the seed classification is kept and a 'discrepancy' field records what was observed. Nothing is marked official unless its nameservers are eva/mario.ns.cloudflare.com, it redirects to an official host, or the seed says so.
